prompt: A muddy old trade road winding across rolling moorland under a heavy grey sky, a broken milestone, distant hills, a few crows.
A foggy marsh at dusk: black water between reeds and dead trees, a rotting wooden walkway, will-o'-the-wisp lights in the distance.
A narrow mountain pass between jagged dark cliffs, snow on the peaks, a rope bridge over a deep gorge, cold wind and mist.
The overgrown ruins of an ancient temple on a hill: broken columns, a collapsed dome, carved stone faces covered in moss, evening light.
Inside an ancient ruined temple hall: tall cracked pillars, a mosaic floor partly buried in sand, shafts of light from holes in the roof, a sealed stone door.
A crowded little market town square at night during a harvest festival: lanterns strung between timber houses, stalls, a bonfire, a stone church tower.
The great hall of a gloomy country manor: a long dining table, tall candelabras, faded tapestries, portraits of stern ancestors, rain on the tall windows.
A large dark cave lit by a single campfire: rough rock walls, stolen crates and barrels piled up, a narrow tunnel leading deeper.
A rocky coast under a stormy sky: a shipwreck on the rocks, waves crashing, a lonely lighthouse on a cliff, seabirds.
A small travellers' camp at night in a forest clearing: a campfire, a covered wagon, tethered horses, bedrolls, stars between the trees.
A rough adult bandit with a scarred face and a hooded cloak, holding one short sword in his right hand, standing on a muddy road.
A big brutal bandit chieftain with a fur mantle and a dented iron helmet, holding one heavy battle axe in both hands, standing in a cave lit by fire.
A giant black cave spider as big as a horse, many glinting eyes, hairy legs, webs hanging around it in a dark cavern.
An adult cultist in a dark red hooded robe with a pale painted face, holding one curved ritual dagger in his right hand, candles behind him.
A tall cult leader in black and crimson robes with a horned silver mask, one hand raised casting a sinister purple flame, an altar behind him.
A huge hunched mountain troll with grey stony skin, long arms and a tree-trunk club, standing on a snowy mountain pass.
A ghostly wraith in tattered black shrouds floating above the ground, a pale skull-like face inside the hood, cold blue light, a ruined hall.
A plump adult travelling merchant in his fifties with a curled moustache, a fur-trimmed coat and many rings, holding one coin purse, beside a covered wagon.
A calm adult temple priestess in her forties in grey and white robes with a silver sun pendant, holding one candle, in a quiet chapel.
A proud adult noblewoman in her thirties in a dark green velvet gown with a lace collar, a cold smile, standing in a candlelit manor hall.
A weathered adult town guard captain in his forties with a grey moustache, wearing a chainmail coat and a blue tabard, one hand on his sword hilt.
An old hedge witch with wild grey hair and sharp green eyes, wearing layered dark shawls with herbs and bones tied to them, in a smoky hut.
A weather-beaten adult fisherman in his sixties with a white beard, a knitted cap and an oilskin coat, holding one fishing net, on a stormy shore.
